# Handheld Companion – Release Notes
## 1.2.1.3 - Improve Viiper device attachment reliability

## What's Changed
• Configure USBIP endpoints dynamically, verify PnP enumeration after attachment, and remove failed devices. Also add virtual-controller failure notifications and asynchronous controller transitions.
• Replace the HandheldCompanion VIIPER DLL and remove the obsolete root-level DLL and generated header.

**Full Changelog**：https://github.com/Valkirie/HandheldCompanion/compare/1.2.1.2...1.2.1.3
